newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wendy's EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wendy's EPS view cut.

text.p: Merrill Lynch analyst Peter Oakes on Thursday lowered earnings estimates for fast-food chain Wendy's International Inc by $0.05 a share to $1.35 in 1997 and $1.60 in 1998.
-- As reported earlier, Merrill Lynch also cut its near-term rating on Wendy's to neutral from accumulate. The long-term rating remains accumulate.
-- On Wednesday, Wendy's reported record second quarter earnings of $0.42 a share, up from $0.38 a year ago. Average sales per restaurant were up 10.3 percent domestically for the quarter.
-- Wendy's also said second half sales comparisons will be harder amidst rising labor and raw material costs and a higher tax rate.
-- In a report, Oakes said that after Wendy's successful introduction of its stuffed pita sandwiches, sales comparisons are getting tougher.
-- "We are impressed with (Wendy's) same store sales gaines over the past year, but the outlook for further momentum is cloudier in our view," Oakes said.
